watch.summary: The creator watches and comments on gameplay footage showing combat and elevator cutscenes.

beats.what: The creator points out that the footage is still using the classic GTA font.
He remarks on how quintessential GTA the scene looks during gunplay.
An NPC in the footage claims his gun isn't loaded before getting shot.
The creator opens his mouth in quiet surprise at the sudden execution.

watch.author: game_itself
watch.key_line: Yeah, they still have the GTA font.
watch.why: This clip is mostly informational reaction to video footage rather than a joke or comedic bit. The only minor laugh comes from a quick NPC exchange in the footage itself.
